for a lease period of 35 (thirty five) years which will be referred to below.
-- This lease according to the description of both parties has occurred and is accepted
using the terms and agreements as mutually agreed upon as follows :
--------- Article 1 ---------
This lease starting from 29-08-2023 (twenty nine August two thousand twenty three)
is made for a period of 35 (thirty five) years the lease expires on
29-08-2058 (twenty nine August two thousand fifty eight).
--------- Article 2 ---------
The rent for the entire period mentioned in Article 1 above is set at [REDACTED],
will be given by the Second Party to the first Party by the following payment systems.
- Payment of the first tranche (DP) in the amount of [REDACTED], has been given by the
Second Party to the First Party before this Deed was signed.
- While the repayment of [REDACTED] will be paid no later than 3 (three) months after
the first phase of payment or on 12-12-2023.
- If on the agreed date mentioned above the Second Party has not made the obligation to
make payment of repayment, then the Second Party, will pay IDR.500,000,00.- (five hundred
thousand rupiah) for every day of delay up to a maximum of 30 (thirty)

--- Page 5 ---
days, and if the Second Party remains negligent, then upon agreement of both Parties
the lease period is only valid for 17 (seventeen) years from the signing of this Deed.
While the remaining rental period is canceled by law without the need to request
annulment from the local District Court.
- The Second Party remains responsible for paying penalties for late payment, in the
amount of IDR.15,000,000.00- (fifteen million Rupiah) within 1 (one) week after default.
--------- Article 3 ---------
Everything that is leased must have been handed over to the Second Party in a good state
of maintenance at the time the lease period begins.

--- Page 8 ---
--------- Article 11 ---------
Upon the agreement of both parties, the first party gives a guarantee to the second party
that this lease can be extended and renewed, if the period mentioned in Article 1 above
has expired or during the rental period, using the terms and agreements in accordance with
the circumstances in time agreed by both parties, namely by renting land at the market
price at the time and based on a comparison at 3 (three) land on locations around lease object.
- The Second Party must notify his will to extend and pay the latest land lease period
1 (one) year prior to the expiration of this lease period.
--------- Article 12 ---------
If these leases expire but the First Party will lease again, then the Second Party is given
the first priority to hold an extension using the terms and agreements and prices to be
agreed and determined later and the First Party is obliged to give top priority to the
Second Party to hold an extension at the agreed price and in accordance with the current
market price (adjusted to the land price) and the ratio of 3 (three) the location of the
land with a radius of 1KM (one kilometer) of the object of the leased land.
question: What is the total lease period agreed in this deed, in years? Answer with the number of years the lease actually runs for under normal performance of the contract.
trap_reason: Article 2 cuts the lease to 17 years ONLY as a penalty if the tenant defaults on payment. A shallow read grabs '17 years' as the lease term.

INFORMASI TATA RUANG BERDASARKAN:
1. Peraturan Daerah Kabupaten Tabanan No. 3 Tahun 2023 tentang Rencana Tata Ruang Wilayah (RTRW) Kabupaten Tabanan
Tahun 2023-2043
Ketentuan Umum Zonasi Kawasan Permukiman Perkotaan Pasal 75 ayat (2).
Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang yang diperbolehkan, meliputi:
1. Perkantoran dan pemerintahan;
2. Perdagangan dan jasa;
3. Sarana pelayanan umum;
4. Sarana transportasi;
5. Pengembangan RTH;
6. Kegiatan pengembangan jaringan sarana prasarana yang mendukung fungsi Kawasan Permukiman Perkotaan;
dan
7. Kegiatan Pemanfaatan Ruang lainnya yang dapat meningkatkan fungsi Kawasan Permukiman Perkotaan.
KETENTUAN YANG BERLAKU:
1. Menerapkan Ketentuan Umum Zonasi Kawasan Permukiman Perkotaan Pasal 75 ayat (2) huruf d. dengan ketentuan
sebagai berikut:
a. Koefisien Dasar Bangunan (KDB) maksimal 60% dari luas persil.
b. Koefisien Lantai Bangunan (KLB) maksimal 2,4.
c. Koefisien Dasar Hijau (KDH) minimal 20% dari luas persil.
d. Ketinggian bangunan maksimal 15 Meter.
2. Menerapkan Perda Nomor 10 Tahun 2023 tentang Penyelenggaraan Bangunan Gedung.
3. Melengkapi dokumen lingkungan dan dokumen lainnya sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku.

expected: no PBG application listed; SLF applied for but not issued (status: documents need correction)
